user_saw: Gateway logs reported advisor reviews blocked by Codex tool policy, sandboxing or exec host=node as `review failed ... fork_failed` instead of saying they were skipped by policy.
summary: Classifies the three pinned Codex /btw policy refusals in the Advisor catch as `review skipped` with tool_policy, sandbox or exec_host_node instead of fork_failed.
reasoning: The reviews were correctly refused by the Codex side-question guards and the fork genuinely did not run, so the existing `fork_failed` log was not wrong, only coarse; the fix adds a finer log classification without changing behavior. This is an observability improvement rather than a broken behavior, so not-a-defect; no causing commit is assigned.
